brief:
Israeli military planners are examining the redeployment of troops currently stationed in Gaza and Lebanon to the occupied West Bank, Shehab Wire reported. The proposal emerges as settler violence and military incursions across the territory have intensified in recent weeks, prompting strategic reassessment within Israeli command structures.

The shift in troop positioning reflects internal security concerns about potential escalation in the West Bank, according to the report. Israeli officials are weighing whether to redirect combat-experienced forces from ongoing operations in Gaza and the Lebanese border to reinforce military presence across Palestinian territories amid mounting tensions and organized settler activism.
